result:
OpenFlowsheet 0.2.0a2 can't represent this case, so I built nothing and ran no solve. I checked the available unit models with `list_models`, and the project is empty (no head revision, no jobs).

- **Property package:** The case needs the WaterTAP ASM2D property package and its reaction package. These are activated-sludge models with ASM2D state variables for soluble and particulate COD, nitrogen, phosphorus and alkalinity. The model families available (`c1.*` and `syn001.*`) are generic molar-flow models with no such property route. Using them would mean replacing the property method and the components, which the task rules out.
- **Reactions:** `fs.R1`–`fs.R4` are CSTRs that run ASM2D kinetic reactions, and `fs.R5`–`fs.R7` are the same with an injection stream. The nearest unit is `syn001.kinetic_cstr`. It takes user-supplied stoichiometry and Damköhler numbers, so it can't use the ASM2D reaction package or its modified phosphorus and solids formulation. It also has no injection port, so no available unit does what `fs.R5`–`fs.R7` do.
- **Recycle flowsheet:** The case data also describes a reactor train with a clarifier, recycle and waste splitters, and a pressure changer (`fs.MX1`, `fs.SP1`, `fs.CL1`, `fs.MX2`, `fs.SP2`, `fs.P1`). I didn't test these separately, since the property package and reactions already block the case.

It has no ASM2D property package (fs.props) and no ASM2D reaction package (fs.rxn_props, the modified phosphorus and solids formulation). Its only kinetic CSTR (syn001.kinetic_cstr) needs user-supplied stoichiometry and Damkohler numbers instead of a reaction package, so it can't stand in for the ASM2D CSTRs (fs.R1-R4).
